tests.name: Model and equality contracts
tests.description: Compare distinct EAST/resin keys, null, unrelated/different keys; reject invalid model fields.
tests.expected: Equal logical keys compare equal and share hashes; invalid fields are rejected; different keys stay different.

tests.name: Parser failure localization
tests.description: Parse the sample and reject malformed second lines, signs, leading zeros and out-of-range units.
tests.expected: Four entries on the sample; checked error identifies the failing 1-based line.

tests.name: Aggregate and sort
tests.description: Process sample data with repeated EAST/resin keys and an empty dataset.
tests.expected: EAST/resin=11, EAST/wire=0, WEST/wire=9; empty dataset has zero totals.

tests.name: CLI and resource integration
tests.description: Run with two paths, wrong argument count, missing input and malformed input with existing output.
tests.expected: Status 0 and Wrote 3 totals. on success; 2 for argument count; 1 for I/O/format errors; malformed input preserves output.

reasoning: EAST/resin appears twice, with 4+7=11 units. WEST/wire has 9 and EAST/wire has 0. Sorting keys by area then material produces EAST/resin, EAST/wire, WEST/wire.
MaterialKey is final and immutable; equality and hash use the same two fields. StockEntry composes the key. Aggregation uses value keys rather than reference identity.
The parser owns no borrowed reader. The CLI owns both file resources and finishes parsing before it opens output. This prevents truncation on parse failure, not all possible partial writes.

The parser creates an ArrayList-backed dataset, bounded by an integer-indexed backing array. At most Integer.MAX_VALUE entries with at most 1000 units each fit in long. Different collection sources would need their own explicit bound or checked arithmetic.
